Coordinate truth boundary

Copy-ready /tp commands use catalog entrances or exact points where available, path starts for routes, and clearly labeled derived centers for area geometry. They are references, not safety-validated arrivals. When the catalog has no narrow usable Y value, the command uses ~ to retain the operator current elevation instead of inventing one. No world edits were made.
